problem_statement: On an ARM64 MMU platform (Cortex-A53), the shared-multi-heap test must declare its DT memory regions using the new devicetree-based ARM64 memory attributes (DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL for cacheable, DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL_NC for non-cacheable) and have those regions mapped through the MMU at compile time, instead of the old ARM MPU attributes (DT_MEM_ARM(ATTR_MPU_RAM)). The shared-multi-heap library must allocate cacheable and non-cacheable chunks into the correct DT-described regions, and the build must succeed using the ARM64 memory-attribute bindings and a sufficient CONFIG_MAX_XLAT_TABLES to map the regions.
